senses.gloss: m. (דָּקָה = b. h. דָּכָה; cmp. דוּק, דקק) crushing; oppression, wrong. תבע ד׳ של־ to ask satisfaction for one’s wrongs, to take one’s part; Gen. R. s. 9, end תובעת ד׳ של וכ׳ protects the wronged; Yalk. Gen. 15 דיקיוס (corr. acc.).
units: <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 20:15">Num. R. s. 20</cite> <he>וכי ד׳ של וכ׳</he> did the angel take up the cause of the ass?; a. e. Cmp. <cite ref="P00767"><he>עְלְבּוֹן</he></cite>.

senses.gloss: , Targ. II Sam. XVII, 19, prob. to be read דְּקִיקִין or דְּקִיקָן (Pesh. דושא) pounded grits; v. next w.
